# bch7al? — design system v4 « Majorelle Nuit »

**Bleu nuit & blanc.** Night-ink hero blocks and text on white, a deep Majorelle ultramarine for actions, night-blue surfaces in dark mode. No green, no red, no yellow — anywhere, including « good / bad » prices. One signature shape, the **bulle** (three round corners, the bottom-left one sharp), taken from the logo.

Single source of truth: `src/tokens.ts`. Screens never use a hex value or a raw number for padding, radius or font size.

## Price direction — without green, red or yellow

Meaning comes from **weight and fill first, hue second, words always**. A chip always carries an arrow, a +/− sign and a word (« Ghali / Normal / Rkhis », « plus cher / moins cher »). Verdict band: within ±5 % of your usual price is « Normal ».

| State | Light (bg / text) | Contrast | Dark (bg / text) | Contrast | Shape |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plus cher · Ghali | `#0E1340` / `#FFFFFF` | 17.71:1 | `#E9E7F3` / `#0F1129` | 15.18:1 | solid, heavy, caret up |
| Moins cher · Rkhis | `#C8E6FF` / `#004C6E` | 7.18:1 | `#004C6E` / `#C8E6FF` | 7.18:1 | light sky, caret down |
| Normal · même prix | `#F0EDF3` / `#464650` | 8.04:1 | `#252840` / `#C7C5D1` | 8.47:1 | neutral, equals sign |
| À vérifier | dashed `#464650` border | — | dashed `#C7C5D1` | — | warning diamond, no hue |
| Erreur (destructive only) | `#8C4383` « Mûre » plum | 6.47:1 | `#FFABF0` | 10.89:1 | warning octagon + verb |

On the night hero block the heavy chip inverts (`#FFFFFF` / `#0E1340`).

Charts: line `#767681`, accent `#2E3FD1`, lowest point `#007FB5` (hollow ring), « ton prix habituel » band `rgba(223,224,255,0.6)`. Step lines (a price changes per trip, never in between), no smoothing, no donut.

Brand (not themed): Majorelle `#2E3FD1`, night `#0E1340`, white, sky `#C8E6FF`. App icon and splash: white bulle with the 7 in Majorelle, on night.

Both OFL (free), both carry Arabic with the Moroccan letters ڭ ڤ گ, both have tabular digits so prices line up. Kufam is for heroes (titles, big numbers); Plex for everything else. Prices: currency after the value with a no-break space (« 12,50 DH »), right-aligned in lists.

## Spacing, radius, sizes

4 dp grid: `xxs` 2 · `xs` 4 · `sm` 8 · `md` 12 · `lg` 16 · `xl` 20 · `xxl` 24 · `section` 32 · `x3` 40 · `x4` 56. The jump from 16 to 32 between sections is what makes hierarchy felt.

Radius: `sm` 8 · `md` 12 · `card` 16 · `hero` 28 · `pill` 999.
Bulle: `lg` 20/20/20/6 · `sm` 12/12/12/4 · `hero` 28/28/28/8 (top-left / top-right / bottom-right / bottom-left). Used on the search field, hero blocks, tiles, chips of advice, the + button.

Sizes: `screen` 20 · `row` 64 · `rowDense` 52 · `touch` 48 · `button` 52 · `input` 52 · `icon` 24 · `iconDense` 20 · `iconInline` 16 · `iconEmpty` 72 · `lead` 40 · `tabBar` 64 · `fab` 60 · `sparkW` 64 · `sparkH` 20.

Elevation: shadows only on things that float (fab, sheet), tinted night. Lists and cards are flat and tonal (`surfaceContainer`).

## Motion

Material 3 springs (damping ratio / stiffness). Spatial (things that move): fast 0.9/1400 · default 0.9/700 · slow 0.9/300. Effects (colour, opacity, no overshoot): fast 1/3800 · default 1/1600 · slow 1/800.

Opening: night background, the white bulle pops in 320 ms, the 7 draws from 200 ms for 420 ms, the name and slogan rise from 520 ms, a 650 ms hold to read « 3ref taman, chri mzyan. », then a 320 ms exit (about 1.8 s in all, no extra wait). Lists fade in 180 ms with a 30 ms stagger. Reduce-motion turns all of it off.

## Icons — Phosphor (MIT)

Regular for UI, **Fill** for the selected tab and active chips, **Duotone** (second tone = `primaryContainer`) for empty states at 72 dp. Grid: 24 dp standard, 20 dp dense, 16 dp inline. Icons take the content colour — never multicolour, never an emoji (a red tomato breaks the colour rule), no sparkle icon for Gemini.

`home` → HouseSimple · `products` → Tag · `list` → ListChecks · `month` → CalendarBlank · `search` → MagnifyingGlass · `settings` → GearSix · `back` → CaretLeft · `next` → CaretRight · `up` → CaretUp · `down` → CaretDown · `close` → X · `check` → Check · `plus` → Plus · `minus` → Minus · `scan` → Scan · `manual` → PencilSimple · `edit` → PencilSimple · `camera` → Camera · `gallery` → Image · `flash` → Lightning · `flashOff` → LightningSlash · `receipt` → Receipt · `text` → FileText · `store` → Storefront · `market` → Basket · `cart` → ShoppingCartSimple · `weight` → Scales · `money` → Coins · `barcode` → Barcode · `priceUp` → TrendUp · `priceDown` → TrendDown · `same` → Equals · `promo` → Percent · `check2` → WarningDiamond · `error` → WarningOctagon · `retry` → ArrowClockwise · `offline` → CloudSlash · `merge` → GitMerge · `link` → LinkSimple · `export` → Export · `import` → DownloadSimple · `credit` → Notebook · `delete` → Trash · `key` → Key · `sun` → Sun · `moon` → Moon · `bread` → Bread · `egg` → Egg · `fish` → Fish · `shrimp` → Shrimp · `meat` → Cow · `veg` → Carrot · `herbs` → Leaf · `fruit` → OrangeSlice · `pepper` → Pepper · `grains` → Grains · `dairy` → Cheese · `drink` → Drop · `coffee` → Coffee · `sweets` → Cookie · `bottle` → Wine · `cleaning` → SprayBottle · `paper` → ToiletPaper · `pack` → Package

## Navigation

Four labelled tabs — **Accueil · Produits · Liste · Mois** — with the bulle **+** in the middle, opening « Scanner le ticket » or « Saisie rapide ». Accueil leads with the « bch7al … ? » question, then the month on a night block.

## Language

French for structure and facts, Darija (Latin letters) for voice: « Ghali / Rkhis », « Mazal ma tqdditi walou », « Bsse7a ! ». Darija never goes into searchable fields.

## Motif

One 8-point zellige star tile, monochrome, ~6 % opacity, only on empty states. Never behind prices, no lanterns, no fake calligraphy.
